name: Track competitor prices and reviews on Amazon, Walmart, eBay

parameters.content:
## Competitor price, stock and review monitor for Amazon, Walmart and eBay

### Who is this for
E-commerce brands, resellers and category managers who sell against the same products on Amazon, Walmart or eBay and need to react when a competitor changes price, runs out of stock or starts collecting bad reviews.

### What it does
Every morning it reads your **Watchlist** tab, fetches each listing with the **API.SH** node (Amazon product, Walmart product or eBay item, chosen from the URL) and compares it with the last check: price drops and rises above your thresholds, the moment a competitor goes under your own price, stock changes, rating drops and new 1-2 star reviews (Amazon and Walmart, for rows with `watch_reviews` set). Every check is added to a **History** tab, the watchlist row is updated, new low-star reviews go to a **Reviews** log (so each one alerts once), and one Slack message lists everything that changed. Every Monday a second schedule posts a week-over-week digest built from the history. Failed lookups go to an **Errors** tab and Slack, and the other products are still checked.

### Setup
1. Install the verified **API.SH** node (nodes panel → search "API.SH"), create a free account at [api.sh](https://api.sh/integrations/n8n?utm_source=n8n&utm_medium=integration&utm_campaign=template-competitor-price-review-monitor) and add your API key as an **API.SH** credential.
2. Create a Google Sheet with a **Watchlist** tab and headers `product`, `platform`, `url`, `our_price`, `watch_reviews`, `active`, `last_price`, `last_rating`, `last_review_count`, `last_units_sold`, `last_in_stock`, `last_change_pct`, `last_checked`, `status`. Fill in product, url (or an ASIN), our_price and watch_reviews (yes/no); the rest is written by the workflow. Add empty tabs **History**, **Reviews** and **Errors**.
3. Open **Settings**: sheet URL, delivery ZIP for Amazon prices, alert thresholds and Slack channel.
4. Connect Google Sheets and Slack and run it once by hand: the first run stores the baseline, alerts start from the second.

### How to customise
- Thresholds live in **Settings**; the rules themselves are in **Compare with history**.
- Review checks cost more than price checks, so turn `watch_reviews` on only where it matters.
- Send **Post changes** to email or a ticket instead of Slack, or add Target or Best Buy listings with another API.SH node in the marketplace switch.

## 1. Schedules and settings
The daily run checks prices; the Monday run builds the weekly digest.

## 2. Load the watchlist
Active rows only; the marketplace comes from the URL.

## 3. Check each listing
One API.SH call per product, routed by marketplace and mapped to one shape. Rows with watch_reviews also fetch the newest reviews. A failed lookup is marked and the loop continues.

## 4. Compare with history
Against the stored price, rating and stock, and the review log.

## Error path
Failed checks go to the Errors tab and one Slack alert.

## 5. Save and alert
Update the watchlist, append history, log new reviews, post one Slack message on days with changes.

## 6. Weekly digest
Mondays: the last 7 days of history per product, biggest moves first.

// One price history row per product per run (the weekly digest reads these)
return $input.all().map(({ json: c }) => ({ json: {
  date: c._p.checked_at.slice(0, 10),
  checked_at: c._p.checked_at,
  product: c._p.product,
  platform: c._p.platform,
  url: c._p.url,
  link: c._p.link,
  price: c._p.price ?? '',
  list_price: c._p.list_price ?? '',
  currency: c._p.currency,
  in_stock: c._p.in_stock,
  rating: c._p.rating ?? '',
  review_count: c._p.review_count ?? '',
  units_sold: c._p.units_sold ?? '',
  seller: c._p.seller,
  change_pct: c._change ?? '',
  our_price: c._p.our_price ?? '',
  new_low_reviews: c._new_reviews.length,
} }));
